bands.name: Forming
bands.meaning: The commercial engine is not yet built. Pick one stage and install the basics before widening.

bands.name: Developing
bands.meaning: Parts of it work. What has been built and what is done daily are not yet pulling together.

bands.name: Established
bands.meaning: A working commercial engine. The next step is making it hold at greater volume.

bands.name: Durable
bands.meaning: Works without the founder in the room and survives more volume. Attention shifts to keeping customers.

note: A few points either side of a band boundary is noise, not a difference in engine.
